blockingFindings.title: R3 coverage omits docs init and docs readme regression checks
blockingFindings.issue: The R3 test only exercises docs enrich plus resolveChaptersOrder fallback for an unknown preset. It does not provide spec-local coverage that docs init and docs readme behavior remain unchanged, even though R3 explicitly requires both.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add spec-local regression coverage for docs init and docs readme behavior relevant to preset resolution/fallback remaining unchanged, or split R3 so the untested init/readme guarantees are removed from this spec's acceptance scope.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The coverage artifact marks R3 as covered, but concrete acceptance requirements for docs init and docs readme have no corresponding executable test coverage.
